company.name: AutoScout24
company.description:
As the largest pan-European online car market with over 2 million vehicle offers,  around 30 million users per month, more than 43,000 car dealer partners and over 800 employees, AutoScout24 offers innovative solutions and empowering services. 

The company's footprint includes the European core markets of Germany, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy, France, Austria, Norway, Denmark, Poland, and Sweden. 

The AutoScout24 Group offers a wide range of automotive solutions, enabling users to find, finance, buy, subscribe to, lease, and sell both used and new cars. As a comprehensive marketplace for mobility, AutoScout24 makes targeted investments in the growth areas of leasing, car subscriptions, electromobility and online car buying.

With AutoScout24 smyle, the marketplace enables its users to buy used cars entirely online and have them delivered right to their doorstep. Fully financed, insured, and registered – ready to drive. Germany's largest marketplace for leasing offers, LeasingMarkt.de, has been part of the AutoScout24 Group since 2020.  The B2B auction platform AUTOproff joined the Group in 2022. Collectively, these marketplaces are significantly driving the digitalization of the European car trade.

AutoScout24 is committed to making the internet a safer place. We are proud to be one of the founding members of the initiative "Sicherer Autokauf im Internet” (Initiative for Safe Car Purchasing Online).
